scope: Prescribed poses, 1 degree steps and 0.1 degree refinement for single-axis probes. SC/AC reference paths follow supplied samples. Alternate paths also check both girdle wires against all rigid geometry and each other; the reported AC-to-GH coronal angle is a scapular orientation proxy. Elbow swivel angles and slider fixed at zero; this deliberately screens that interface condition only. Fixed TPU references and cable actuation are outside this rigid motion audit. Axial signs are source convention.
